import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductCup
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleGenerator
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietorisNaturality

/-!
# Naturality of the circle-product connecting summand

The ordered overlap coordinates and the actual Mayer--Vietoris connecting
map commute with maps of the first factor. In particular the degree-one class
used in the circle-product cup formula is natural in that factor.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Prod.instModule

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The circle-product connecting map is natural in the first factor. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyConnecting_naturality {X Y : TopCat}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology Y n × IntegralSingularCohomology Y n) :
    circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n
      (singularCohomologyPullback f n a.1, singularCohomologyPullback f n a.2) =
      singularCohomologyPullback (circleProductMap f) (n + 1)
        (circleProductCohomologyConnecting Y v n a) := by
  have h := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_naturality
    (circleProductMap f)
    (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    (circleProductChart Y v) (circleProductChart Y (-v))
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
    (circleProductChart_open_cover Y v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover Y v).2.1
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 (circleProductChart_open_cover Y v).2.2
    (fun _ hp => hp) (fun _ hp => hp) n
    ((circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv Y v n).symm a)
  let hf : Set.MapsTo (circleProductMap f)
      (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v))
      (circleProductChart Y v ∩ circleProductChart Y (-v)) :=
    fun _ hp => hp
  have hmap : singularSubsetContinuousMap (circleProductMap f) hf =
      circleProductOverlapMap f v := by
    rfl
  have hp :
      singularCohomologyPullback
          (singularSubsetContinuousMap (circleProductMap f) hf) n
          ((circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv Y v n).symm a) =
        (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm
          (singularCohomologyPullback f n a.1,
            singularCohomologyPullback f n a.2) := by
    apply (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).injective
    rw [hmap, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_naturality,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  dsimp [circleProductCohomologyConnecting] at h ⊢
  rw [← hp]
  exact h

/-- The ordered degree-one connecting class is natural in the first factor. -/
theorem circleProductConnectingClass_naturality {X Y : TopCat}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : Circle) :
    singularCohomologyPullback (circleProductMap f) 1
      (circleProductConnectingClass Y v) = circleProductConnectingClass X v := by
  have h := circleProductCohomologyConnecting_naturality f v 0
    (singularCohomologyOne Y, 0)
  simpa only [circleProductConnectingClass, singularCohomologyOne,
    singularCohomologyPullback_class, singularCocyclePullback_one, map_zero] using h.symm

/-- The connecting class on a product comes from the normalized circle class. -/
theorem circleProductConnectingClass_eq_pullback_antipodal (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    circleProductConnectingClass X v =
      singularCohomologyPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom ⟨(Prod.snd : X × Circle → Circle), continuous_snd⟩) 1
        (circleAntipodalClass v) := by
  rw [circleAntipodalClass]
  change circleProductConnectingClass X v =
    ((singularCohomologyPullback _ 1).comp (singularCohomologyPullback _ 1)) _
  rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_comp]
  exact (circleProductConnectingClass_naturality
    (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun _ : X => (), continuous_const⟩) v).symm

/-- The circle-product decomposition uses the pullback of a primitive circle class. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_symm_apply_circle_cup (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1))
    (b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    (circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm (a, b) =
      circleProductCohomologyPullback X (n + 1) a +
        singularCohomologyCup (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 1 n (n + 1) (by omega)
          (singularCohomologyPullback
            (TopCat.ofHom ⟨(Prod.snd : X × Circle → Circle), continuous_snd⟩) 1
            (circleAntipodalClass v)) (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b) := by
  rw [circleProductCohomologyEquiv_symm_apply_cup,
    circleProductConnectingClass_eq_pullback_antipodal]

end Mumford.Analytic
